sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: A bodyguard operating in Lumlux's underworld. Though kind-hearted and gentle by nature, his awkward manner and blunt speech bred constant misunderstandings, and people mistook him for a thug. Whenever he saw someone in trouble, he couldn't stop himself from helping, which repeatedly dragged him into brawls. The Royal Knights arrested him more than once, and even their captain lectured him in person: upholding justic is noble but the means must be right. Still, his path kept leading him deeper into places where no light could reach.

|member = |gamedebut = |aliases = |counterpart = Ardent Victory Addik |bf2 = true }} '''Addik''' is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. ==In-Game Appearance== ==Background== ==History== ===Brave Frontier Heroes=== A bodyguard operating in Lumlux's underworld. Though kind-hearted and gentle by nature, his awkward manner and blunt speech bred constant misunderstandings, and people mistook him for a thug. Whenever he saw someone in trouble, he couldn't stop himself from helping, which repeatedly dragged him into brawls. The Royal Knights arrested him more than once, and even their captain lectured him in person: upholding justic is noble but the means must be right.
